- Clicking a path dot moves the player onto it; the player's previous cell becomes a new dot (path preserved). Confirmed: clicked (55,8), player moved there, new dot at (53,10).
- So the player can walk the dotted path dot-by-dot in either direction. Goal is likely the blue blob (top-right end of path).
- Countdown bar ~58px, shrinking ~2px/action — need to be efficient.
- Plan: batch clicks up the path: (53,10)→(51,12)→…→(17,46), then inspect before final blob move.
